parts.problem_md:
A farmer uses an automated robot to plant seeds in the field.

The robot is adapted to have machine learning capabilities.

**Explain **how this will improve the robot.
parts.solution_md:
Examples of improvements to the robot with machine learning capabilities include:

Any **two **of the following:

- The robot can now adapt itself by changing its own rules/data/processes **[1 mark]**
- The robot will become more efficient **[1 mark]**
- … as it has a greater knowledge of its surroundings/environment **[1 mark]**
- … as it can remember where a fence is **[1 mark]**
- … as it can remember the route it needs to take **[1 mark]**
- … as it can remember where any obstacles are to avoid **[1 mark]**
- … as it can remember where to start and stop sowing seeds **[1 mark]**
- … as it may make fewer errors **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
An expert system is an example of artificial intelligence. One component of an expert system is a knowledge base.

**Identify three **other components that are present in an expert system.
parts.solution_md:
**Three **other components in an expert system are:

- Rule base **[1 mark]**
- Inference engine **[1 mark]**
- Interface **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
An expert system can make use of machine learning.

**State** what is meant by machine learning.
parts.solution_md:
Machine learning is when:

- A program has the ability to (automatically) adapt to its own processes and/or data **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
An expert system is an example of artificial intelligence. One component of an expert system is a knowledge base.

**Explain why** an expert system needs a knowledge base.
parts.solution_md:
An expert system needs a knowledge base because:

- It needs facts **[1 mark]**
- … to generate the rules **[1 mark]**
- … to make the decisions **OR** The data it contains is essential to the decision making process **[1 mark]**
